home_meta_title: Dashnut: Flying squirrel. Beat the ghost.
home_meta_description: Race a golden ghost through short courses as a flying squirrel. Dashnut is a free 2D time trial runner coming soon to Android and iOS.
home_og_image_alt: Dashnut, a flying squirrel, racing the golden ghost in The Mill.
home_hero_intro: Dashnut is a 2D time trial runner starring a small flying squirrel who runs right automatically. You tap and swipe through short courses to match or beat the golden ghost's time for gold.
home_hero_image_alt: Dashnut leaping through The Mill with the golden ghost just ahead.
home_shots_intro: Get a look at Dashnut's worlds, quick moves and races against the clock.
feature_ghost_text: Match or beat its time for gold. Earn bronze, silver and gold medals on each course, and chase your own local personal best.
feature_worlds_text: From The Mill to Sunbanner Citadel, run eight courses in each of five worlds, plus the tutorial Find your feet.
feature_controls_text: Tap to hop. Swipe to leap, slide, dash or brake. Dashnut runs right automatically, so every move and every moment counts.
feature_acorns_text: Two optional acorns per course: all twelve from a world’s six main courses unlock its seventh. Gold on all six unlocks a faster Prism course.
feature_retry_text: Courses last about 45 seconds. If you fall, you'll restart automatically after a short moment. Play offline without an account.
home_worlds_intro: Run from warm timber through copper leaves, frost and spring gardens to sunlit stone.
world_mill_text: Warm timber meets heavy machinery, with saws and presses waiting along your route.
world_kitewoods_text: Kites and cloth flutter among copper leaves, with hawks and silver branches ahead.
world_frostwell_text: Frozen arches meet warm water, melting frost pillars and falling ice.
world_bloomworks_text: A factory blooms among spring gardens, living roots, glass, petals and lasers.
world_citadel_text: Sunlit stone frames moving defenses, cannons, catapults and knights.
home_controls_intro: Play in landscape with taps and swipes, without buttons on the screen.
control_leap_text: Leap onto a higher beam and float back down.
control_slide_text: Slide under machinery or drop down.
control_dash_text: Dash forward with a short burst of speed.
control_brake_text: Brake briefly to time your move through a gap.
home_cta_text: Your race against the clock is coming soon to Google Play and the App Store as a free download.
support_meta_description: Get help with Dashnut's controls, ghosts, course unlocks and saved progress. Find answers about offline play, language settings, privacy and resetting records.
support_intro: Stuck on a move or unsure about your progress? Check the answers below or send an email for help.
support_contact_text: Send an email with your question, and include your device and app version to help identify the problem.
faq_controls_a: You run right automatically. Tap to hop, swipe up for a high leap that floats down, swipe down to slide or drop, swipe right to dash, and swipe left to brake briefly. Play in landscape, without buttons on the screen.
faq_ghost_q: What is the golden ghost, and can I hide it?
faq_ghost_a: The golden ghost runs a fast line. Match or beat its time for gold, even when hidden. Hide it in Settings, where you can also switch on a ghost of your personal best.
faq_unlock_q: How do I unlock more courses?
faq_unlock_a: Each course has exactly two optional large acorns on harder routes. In each world, collect all twelve from the six main courses to unlock the seventh. Earn gold on all six main courses to unlock the eighth, a faster Prism course.
faq_progress_a: Your progress, records and settings are saved only on this device. You don't need an account, and there's no cloud sync. Uninstalling the app deletes this saved data.
faq_reset_q: How do I reset my records?
faq_reset_a: Open Settings and choose "Reset records". After you confirm, your records are reset and your settings are kept.
faq_language_q: Which languages can I play in?
faq_language_a: You can play in English or German. Change the language in Settings.
faq_offline_q: Do I need an internet connection?
faq_offline_a: No. Dashnut plays offline, and you don't need an account.
faq_privacy_q: What data does the game collect?
faq_privacy_a: The current version of Dashnut collects no personal data. Progress, records and settings stay on your device. Read the Privacy Policy for details.
